scope: 本轮微信账号分流、头像路径化与安全解绑客户端最终验证
sideEffects: VM 的 wx.request、wx.login、文件与存储均为内存模拟；浏览器所有 API 均被 page.route 内存 fixture 拦截，没有向开发库发送任何写请求。

mini.kind: Real miniprogram Mine/request/avatar modules in VM; all network, storage and image operations are in-memory mocks

checks.name: unknown WeChat 409 preserves guest auth and pending club without resuming
explicit create gets a fresh wx.login code and createAccount true before restoring pending club
existing password account binds a fresh WeChat identity then restores pending club
failed post-login binding retains the pending invitation
temporary avatar preview survives compression failure with PNG MIME and upload precedes nickname-only profile
oversized or unsupported avatar files do not reach upload or profile endpoints
request normalizes nested short avatar URLs and preserves error.status and error.code
unlink prompts for an account password first, rejects missing or wrong proof, then clears the binding

mini.contract: 小程序使用 POST /me/avatar 上传图片，随后 PUT /me/profile 只提交昵称；API 短头像路径归一化为 baseURL 完整 URL。

web.kind: Real Web Mine in Playwright with every API request fulfilled from in-memory fixtures

checks.name: short URL avatar renders, local preview works, compatibility PUT returns a short avatar URL
later nickname change sends the current short URL instead of image Base64

web.contract: Web 保留 PUT /me/profile 的图片兼容上传；保存后使用 API 返回的短 URL，再次改昵称仅携带既有短 URL。

limitations: 原生编译器完成离线 WXML/WXSS 编译；VM 和浏览器验证不等同于微信客户端或真机微信授权流程。
